name: Select TOTP
summary: From Select MFA Type, the user chooses TOTP and the client opens the existing TOTP Start surface.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.select.mfa-type is visible with TOTP available

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the canonical TOTP Start surface is visible

sourceReferences.note: Starting surface owns the select-totp action.
Existing canonical TOTP Start surface owns the remaining TOTP ceremony.
Angular action:select-totp navigates to the canonical TOTP continuation route.
Select MFA Type has exactly one TOTP-choice scenario ending at TOTP Start.
